parts.key_points_summary: This module introduces core economic concepts like scarcity, supply & demand, specialization, and GDP, forming the foundation for understanding macroeconomic principles.
learning_objectives: Define and explain the concept of scarcity and its implications.
Describe the principles of supply and demand and their interaction in markets.
Illustrate the benefits of specialization in production.
Understand the basic definition and measurement of Gross Domestic Product (GDP).
parts.title: Fundamental Economic Concepts

parts.key_points_summary: We delve deeper into understanding how scarcity drives economic choices, how supply and demand influence pricing and market equilibrium and the importance of specialization in boosting productivity.
learning_objectives: Analyze the impact of scarcity on economic decision-making.
Apply supply and demand analysis to real-world scenarios.
Evaluate the role of specialization in increasing productivity.
Discuss the limitations of GDP as a measure of economic well-being.
parts.title: Scarcity, Supply and Demand, and Specialization

parts.key_points_summary: This module focuses on measuring and interpreting economic activity through GDP, differentiating between nominal and real values and understanding GDP's components.
learning_objectives: Calculate and interpret GDP using different approaches.
Differentiate between nominal and real GDP.
Explain the components of GDP and their contributions to economic growth.
Analyze the relationship between GDP and other macroeconomic indicators.
parts.title: GDP and Economic Activity

parts.key_points_summary: This explores topics in scarcity and S&D, and is applicable to more advanced topics.
parts.title: Advanced Concepts of Scarcity, Supply, Demand, and Specialization

parts.key_points_summary: This module focuses on measuring and interpreting economic activity through GDP, differentiating between nominal and real values and understanding GDP's components.
learning_objectives: Explain the components of GDP and their contributions to economic growth.
Analyze the relationship between GDP and other macroeconomic indicators.
parts.title: GDP and Macroeconomics
